summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised. All 8 browser checks and all 3 backend test files (7 pytest cases) pass. No bugs found.
note_criteria_count: Acceptance matrix has exactly 8 criteria; all 8 covered (one browser check each, plus 3 backend test files for API-bearing criteria: auditoria, promociones status, ventas permissions).

checks.criterion: Login con roles y gating de rutas
checks.name: auth-login-role-gating
checks.evidence: Unauthenticated visit to /stock redirected to /login; wrong password showed 'Credenciales incorrectas' toast and stayed on /login; vendedor login showed role VENDEDOR in user-profile; logout returned to /login and /stock again redirected; admin login showed role ADMIN.

checks.criterion: El asistente IA responde en streaming usando SOLO los datos de la base y nunca inventa
checks.name: asistente-chat-streaming-grounded
checks.evidence: chat-thinking appeared then resolved; T-Roc query response (ai-response-content) contained CB-1021/CB-1033/CB-1034 with prices and source-pill elements; Amarok query produced '⚠️ No tengo este dato confirmado...' disclaimer with no invented price. Backend /api/chat SSE stream confirmed via curl to include the same stock numbers/prices.

checks.criterion: Página de Stock: filtros combinables y las dos vistas
checks.name: stock-filters-combinable
checks.evidence: stock-result-count showed '23 de 23 unidades' then '6 de 23 unidades' after max-price=32000 with all visible card prices <=32000; 'Limpiar filtros' restored 23; stock-table view showed 23 rows; cards view restored; 'Ver ficha' navigated to vehiculo-detalle-page.

checks.criterion: Ficha de vehículo completa con todas sus pestañas
checks.name: vehicle-detail-tabs
checks.evidence: T-Roc R-Line and ID.4 Pro detail pages showed vehicle-price/vehicle-monthly; all 7 tabs (resumen, equipamiento, tecnico, stock, financiacion, argumentario, faq) rendered non-empty content; financiacion tab showed the verification warning text and vehicle-financing-* cards.

checks.criterion: Comparador de hasta 4 vehículos con resalte de diferencias
checks.name: comparador-max-four
checks.evidence: Empty state shown initially; adding 4 vehicles produced comparador-table with 5 header columns (label + 4); add selector showed 'Máximo 4 vehículos' at cap; Potencia row had exactly 1 highlighted best cell; compare-remove-* removed a column; 'Vaciar comparativa' returned to comparador-empty.

checks.criterion: Promociones: estado calculado con fecha de hoy
checks.name: promotions-status-tabs
checks.evidence: Vigentes tab hid 'Taigo Verano' and 'Golf GTI Lanzamiento'; Finalizadas tab showed both with promo-status-finalizada badges; Activas tab showed promo-status-activa; Próximas tab showed promo-status-proxima including 'T-Roc Edición Limitada'.

checks.criterion: Promociones: estado calculado con fecha de hoy (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_promotions_status.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/promotions -> 200; 'Taigo Verano' and 'Golf GTI Lanzamiento' status == 'finalizada'; 'T-Roc Edición Limitada' status == 'proxima'; at least one of activa/proxima/programada present.

checks.criterion: Auditoría determinista de datos: confirma, avisa o rechaza
checks.name: auditoria-ui-confirmado
checks.evidence: T-Roc @ 35020 -> audit-result-estado contains CONFIRMADO with matches/sources; T-Roc @ 99999 -> estado not CONFIRMADO; Taigo promo @ 2000 -> estado INCORRECTO/DESACTUALIZADO with 'finaliz...' text.

checks.name: test_tscheck_audit_deterministic.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/audit {T-Roc,35020} -> 200, estado=confirmado with tarifa/stock matches and sources; {T-Roc,99999} -> estado!=confirmado; {Taigo promo,2000} -> estado=incorrecto, mensaje mentions campaign ended.

checks.criterion: Ventas y comisiones: registrar venta actualiza tabla y KPIs; permiso de borrado respetado
checks.name: ventas-register-sale-updates-kpis
checks.evidence: ventas-table started with 4 rows; submitting without client/PVP left 4 rows; full form (PVP 52470, descuento 2470) added a 5th row, kpi-month-sales incremented by 1, kpi-month-commission changed; deleting the created sale returned to 4 rows and reverted kpi-month-sales.

checks.criterion: Ventas y comisiones: permiso de borrado por rol (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_sales_permissions.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/sales (tscheck-sale-*, pvp=52470, discount=2470) -> commission_estimated=1500.0, appears in GET /api/sales, DELETE succeeds and removes it. Separately: vendedor DELETE /api/sales/{admin-owned-sale} -> 403, and the sale remained present afterward.
